vendoring_decision.reference_documents: Tracked because offline authoring, promotion, parser, request-shape, and unsupported-venue tests need complete normalized reference documents and named counter-examples. Operation recordings contain provider response envelopes, not this static reference contract; fetch-on-demand would make the offline suite depend on network access.
vendoring_decision.manifest: Tracked beside the documents because it defines the closed 16-document inventory and pins its provenance. Without it a fresh clone could not validate slice completeness or compare the upstream revision with the authoring workbench.
